google_workspace_admin_new_or_updated_us.description: Runs when new or updated user is observed in Google Workspace Admin. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

google_workspace_admin_new_organizationa.description: Runs when new organizational unit is observed in Google Workspace Admin. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
